chapters.title: QUAD OVERBOUGHT
chapters.text: All four lanes' %D (9 · 3, 14 · 3, 40 · 4, 60 · 10) close at or above 80 on the same bar. The panel arms short until the 60 · 10 crosses back through 50, or for 100 bars.

chapters.title: PRIME ROTATION
chapters.text: Armed short since the quad, the 9 · 3 %D closes back below 80 (70) and falls again on this close (51). A bearish divergence was born in the lanes while the panel was armed, so it is PRIME.

chapters.title: LATCH RELEASED
chapters.text: The slow 60 · 10 %D closes back below 50 (46.4): the short arm is released. The latch reads not armed until the next quad.
